reviews.title: Scam and hidden fees
reviews.text:
Avoid this app at all costs. The business model is designed to trick users into spending far more than initially advertised.
Even after signing up for the "free trial," most of the essential features remain locked. To actually use the app as intended, you are forced to pay for a "premium" tier that costs twice as much as the standard subscription. Furthermore, the pricing is predatory for families; there is no shared plan, and you have to pay the full annual subscription price for every single family member you add.
Beyond the financial red flags, there are serious privacy concerns. The app harvests an excessive amount of personal data that has nothing to do with its functionality. It is also clear that they are inflating their rating with fake reviews to mask these issues.
Do not waste your money or risk your data. Stick to much safer, free alternatives like Apple Family or Google Family Link. They offer better security and genuine family sharing without the hidden traps.

reviews.title: Took money without warning
reviews.text:
I stopped using this app almost a year ago and was very surprised to discover that my annual subscription had been renewed and charged without any prior notification.

I believe it is poor practice not to send a reminder email before an annual renewal is taken, particularly when a customer has not actively used the service for such a long period. Had I received notice that the subscription was due to renew, I would have cancelled it.

What makes this even more frustrating is that the company does not issue refunds, leaving customers with little recourse once the charge has been taken. This feels quite scammy and unfair, especially when no advance reminder is provided.

As a result, I feel disappointed by this experience, as it appears to prioritise automatic renewal over transparent communication with customers. For this reason, I will not be continuing to use the app.

reviews.title: Intrusive Ads Compromise Child Safety
reviews.text:
The fundamental purpose of this app is to ensure my child's safety and track their journey to/from school. However, the intrusive full-screen pop-up ads are actively undermining this. Twice, while trying to quickly check the map, the app has redirected me to an external website for commercial deals (e.g., Black Friday).
This is unacceptable. A child safety app must prioritize its primary function. These forced redirects create dangerous friction and distraction when I need to quickly and reliably access my child's status. Please remove these interruptive pop-ups immediately
